title: Beef Kaldereta Stir Fry
description: A Chinese-inspired twist on the classic Filipino beef kaldereta dish. This stir-fry is quick, easy, and packed with flavor.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove the beef from the wok and set aside.
Add the garlic and ginger to the wok and stir-fry until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add the kaldereta sauce, soy sauce, oyster sauce (if using), and brown sugar to the wok.
Stir to combine and bring the sauce to a simmer.
Return the beef to the wok and stir to coat with the sauce.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened and the beef is cooked through.
Stir in the chopped scallions and serve hot over rice.
Optional: serve with steamed vegetables or noodles for a more filling meal.
